newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said there would be a donor information meeting for Bosnia-Herzegovina on Thursday and Friday co-hosted by the Commission and the World Bank and followed by a news conference at 1245/1145 GMT in the Breydel news room.
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had adopted a method for calculating fines resulting from non-application of Court of Justice judgments (article 171 of the EU Treaty).

He said fines would be based on a daily lump sum multiplied by coefficients, taking account of the infraction's gravity and duration and of the member state's financial situation. Van der Pas insisted that the Commission had only proposed a method of calculation and that a final decision would be taken by the Court of Justice.
Van der Pas said former DGXXIV Director General Spyros Pappas had been nominated as new DGX Director General.
He said the Commission had decided to take safeguard measures for the import of rice from overseas countries and territories.

Van der Pas said that during its orientation debate on the inter-governmental conference the Commission had emphasised the need to concentrate on flexibility and institutional issues. He said the Commission would prepare a contribution before the ministerial meeting on flexibility that shall take place on January 20.
In answer to a question, van der Pas said the Commission and the new Dutch Presidency had similar views on this issue.

Spokesman Patrick Child said the texts on EMU to be finalized during the Dutch Presidency of the European Council would include resolutions on a new exchange rate mechanism and the stability pact. He said there would also be two draft regulations on the framework of the stability pact and final adoption of a regulation on the legal basis for the euro.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/4: Commission funds 20 Mecus for cross-border cooperation between Italy and Switzerland.
- IP/97/5: Commission adpots new method of calculating sanctions that will be proposed to the Court of Justice on the basis of Article 171 of the EU Treaty.
- IP/97/6: Safeguard measures for the import of rice from overseas countries and territories.
- IP/97/7: Commission/World Bank to host preparatory donors meeting for Bosnia and Herzegovina- January 9-10, 1997.
- IP/97/8: Commission decides to extend its procedure on Greek aid to the Hellenic shipyard.
- IP/97/9: Commission decides to widen its investigations on Spanish aid to public-owned shipbuilding.
